info.name: TBS PFE API
info.description: Flask REST API for previous TBS PFE reports. Select the environment 'TBS PFE Local'. Tokens are saved automatically after login/refresh.

item.name: 1. Demo script
item.description: Run in order on a FRESH server started with a 30-second access token. This is the video script.

console.log("Waiting " + s + " s for the access token to expire...");

request.description: Postman waits {{wait_seconds}} s before sending (set 0 to wait yourself). Requires the server to run with ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRES_SECONDS=30.
Sends the REFRESH token as Bearer. Old refresh token is kept in old_refresh_token for D12, then both tokens are replaced.
